what: Why the v3 champion's dev answers are not fully supported (iteration 3 error analysis)
method: Eight reader agents (Explore type: no inherited session instructions; read-only tools; Opus, high effort) each took 10 or 11 failing answers, listed every unsupported claim under the judge's rubric and gave each the first applicable cause, checking the text of every page the agent read or cited. A ninth reader re-read 15 answers independently. Workflow script: results/iteration-3/error-analysis-workflow.js; export: scripts/export_unsupported_claims.py.
